Name: Hymenaeus
Role: Teacher who erred and was delivered to Satan
Summary: Hymenaeus was named by Paul in 1 Timothy among those delivered unto Satan that they might learn not to blaspheme, and in 2 Timothy as one whose teaching, with Philetus, said the resurrection was past already and overthrew the faith of some.
KeyStory: Hymenaeus was named by Paul in 1 Timothy among those delivered unto Satan that they might learn not to blaspheme, and in 2 Timothy as one whose teaching, with Philetus, said the resurrection was past already and overthrew the faith of some.
LifeLesson: Wrong teaching about the resurrection overthrows faith; truth must be guarded, not trimmed.
